answer: Reputation then accrues only through peer-attested work, like jade polished by repeated handling. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a quartz token locked on a public ledge for a full epoch; forging identities means locking fresh quartz per key, so a thousand fake agents drain real capital. Attackers must burn stake faster than honest agents earn it, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
